text: {"rules":[{"id":"CVD-DIET-ACTIVITY-COUNSEL-RISK","version":"November 2020","title":"Behavioral counseling for healthy diet and physical activity in adults with cardiovascular disease risk factors","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends offering or referring adults with cardiovascular disease risk factors to behavioral counseling interventions to promote a healthy diet and physical activity.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2020-11","action":"Offer or refer adults with cardiovascular disease risk factors to behavioral counseling interventions to promote a healthy diet and physical activity.","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adults\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"text says 'adults' without an age; 18 years assumed as the adult threshold\"}}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"presence of cardiovascular disease risk factors (the text does not define which risk factors qualify)\"}, \"quote\": \"adults with cardiovascular disease risk factors\"}]}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"cvd_behavioral_counseling\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"behavioral counseling interventions to promote a healthy diet and physical activity\", \"note\": \"Offer or referral both satisfy the recommendation.\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text gives no interval; measurement year assumed for checking\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept 'cvd_behavioral_counseling' (offer of, or referral to, behavioral counseling for healthy diet and physical activity) is not in the concept vocabulary.","The text does not define which cardiovascular disease risk factors qualify (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidemia, elevated risk score). This criterion is encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated with specific diagnoses.","'Adults' has no stated age; a minimum age of 18 is derived and declared for human review.","No counseling interval or frequency is stated; the measurement-year window is derived for review.","Counseling intensity, format, duration and content are not represented.","The asterisk after the date ('November 2020 *') refers to an unexplained footnote that is not included in the section."]}
